_doc: The Sinnoh Pokemon League ladder for the NPC tower (lib/npc-pokemon.js, plugins/poketower.js). Ordered climb: 8 Gym Leaders, then the Elite Four, then Champion Cynthia at the top. `stage` is the 1-based rung. Each master has a fixed team of species `dex` ids fought one after another (the player's single main Pokemon is fully healed between each master's mons, not between rungs). `level` is the level every mon on that rung is built at, climbing with depth. `reward` pays out once, the first time that rung is cleared: solars plus gems on the marquee rungs. Copy is player-facing, no dashes.

masters.name: Roark
masters.title: Oreburgh Gym Leader
masters.intro: So you want to test your mettle against stone. Come then, show me what you dig up.
masters.defeat: Impressive. Your resolve cuts deeper than any pickaxe of mine.

masters.name: Gardenia
masters.title: Eterna Gym Leader
masters.intro: Ehehe, you have a strong look in your eyes. But grass grows over the strongest of ruins.
masters.defeat: You uprooted me completely. Well earned, challenger.

masters.name: Maylene
masters.title: Veilstone Gym Leader
masters.intro: Let us bow, and then let us not hold back. I want your very best.
masters.defeat: That last blow, I felt it in my spirit. Thank you for the fight.

masters.name: Crasher Wake
masters.title: Pastoria Gym Leader
masters.intro: CRASH! Here comes the tidal wave, do you think you can ride it out?
masters.defeat: The tide turned on me. A magnificent current you have, challenger.

masters.name: Fantina
masters.title: Hearthome Gym Leader
masters.intro: Bonjour. Shall we dance among the shadows, you and I?
masters.defeat: Non, you are no illusion. Your strength is quite real.

masters.name: Byron
masters.title: Canalave Gym Leader
masters.intro: My defenses are forged of iron. Break through them if you can!
masters.defeat: Even steel yields to a will strong enough. You have proven yours.

masters.name: Candice
masters.title: Snowpoint Gym Leader
masters.intro: Brrr, it is cold up here. Let us see if your passion can melt my ice!
masters.defeat: You burned right through the blizzard. Incredible warmth in you.

masters.name: Volkner
masters.title: Sunyshore Gym Leader
masters.intro: I was bored of easy wins. Please, give me a battle worth remembering.
masters.defeat: There it is. That spark. You have reminded me why I love this.

masters.name: Aaron
masters.title: Elite Four
masters.intro: The League begins here. Bug types are not weak, and neither am I.
masters.defeat: You saw past the swarm. On you go, the others are waiting.

masters.name: Bertha
masters.title: Elite Four
masters.intro: You are young and fierce. This old woman will ground you all the same.
masters.defeat: Heh. The earth shifts for the strong. You may pass, dear.

masters.name: Flint
masters.title: Elite Four
masters.intro: My Pokemon burn with everything I have. Do not get scorched.
masters.defeat: You put out my flames without flinching. That takes real heat.

masters.name: Lucian
masters.title: Elite Four
masters.intro: The mind is the final gate before the Champion. Let us see if yours holds.
masters.defeat: Your focus never wavered. Cynthia awaits you now. Go.

masters.name: Cynthia
masters.title: Sinnoh Champion
masters.intro: I have waited at the top for someone like you. Do not disappoint me. Give me everything.
masters.defeat: So this is the trainer who reaches the summit. I have never been prouder to lose. You are, without question, a Champion.
